name: George Sarris
headline: Vice President of Professional Services at PRO-telligent, LLC, a Tetra Tech Company
companyName: PRO-telligent, LLC, a Tetra Tech Company
about:
- Seasoned, Top Secret cleared (SCI Eligible) management professional with extensive experience in managing, analyzing, and providing IT and Professional Service solutions to Federal and Commercial customers (~27 years of Management and ~6 years of Technical Lead/Programmer Analyst experience)
• Responsible for 500+ personnel, comprised of employees, VARs, subcontractors, having total contract award of $416M, demonstrating success growing a positive client relation, and exceptional service delivery
- Grew IT Division over 200% in 3 years, including 7 subcontractors and 10 consultants across 12 clients
- Leads a division within our $3.6B company where I manage a team of Directors, Program Managers, and Senior Project Managers with the implementation of technical and non-technical international projects
- Serves as primary client and partner point of contact to manage customer/partner relations 
- Leads strategic planning and growth of my unit, including capture and business development pursuits, hiring/interview process, and human capital management/career development.
- Significant experience working with geographically distributed teams, including local labor laws and local nationals
- Supported project travel to more than 120 countries over the 5 years prior to the pandemic
- Served as the Quality Management System Representative for our unit to earn our ISO 9001 QMS certification, document repeatable processes, and provide supporting documentation for audits
- Possesses a PMP and Lean Six Sigma certifications as well as been trained in SAFe Agile
